Installed third-party notices for Novel Studio. JavaScript bundles include MIT/ISC/Apache-2.0 packages and their notices. SAPI5 is a Windows system interface; comtypes is MIT. External Pandoc 3.12.1 is NOT included in the release ZIP (GPL-2.0-or-later, https://pandoc.org). UI font selection uses system fonts. PDF standard fonts are redistributed from pinned pdfjs-dist with their notices; corresponding Liberation source is under font-source. Local art uses Lucide icons under ISC. PyInstaller bootloader redistribution uses its GPL exception. See individual files for complete terms.
